baseRelease: rc15-compatible local iPhone collector validation core; published Mac rc16 and website Android rc9 are separate apps
runtime: Windows x64 CPython 3.12 with bundled Tcl/Tk; frozen helper and window runtimes are separate
reviewProtocol: 200-contact searchable preview pages, cross-page selected IDs, 1000-ID review pages with exact UUID and SHA-256 selection binding; browser v2 immutable source pages and verified saved ACK remain in the shared engine
wrapperOnedir: dist/AmplifaiPhone/{AmplifaiPhone.exe,_internal/}; external resources/ staged beside the wrapper executable, not inside wrapper _internal/
helperOnedir: dist/AmplifaiPhoneHelper/{AmplifaiPhoneHelper.exe,_internal/}; copy the entire matching tree without flattening into wrapper resources/phone-helper/
resourceChecks: frozen-only fixed paths, no symlink/reparse resource entries, readable contained runtime; shape checks do not replace build/hash/signature qualification
childRuntime: fixed helper executable with helper-directory cwd, private stdin/stdout, discarded stderr, shell=false, fresh copied env without PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME and PYINSTALLER_RESET_ENVIRONMENT=1

resources.contract: entire matching frozen AmplifaiPhoneHelper onedir including AmplifaiPhoneHelper.exe and its matching _internal/; not an isolated copied executable or source/PATH fallback
exact COPYRIGHT, LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt byte hashes from the candidate source root

install: WiX 3 per-user limited-privilege MSI to LocalAppDataFolder, unsigned and private draft only; normal non-admin/SmartScreen/driver and physical account acceptance remain unqualified.
releaseGates: complete matching helper runtime/dependency hashes and driver qualification
windowProtocol: 200-contact searchable pages with atomic all-page Select all/Clear all, 1000 selected IDs/review command and exact UUID/hash; server-confirmed signed-in destination approval for code-free Connect, manual one-use code fallback, bounded transfer counters and allowlisted optional source reasons. Account source Save/readback/Finalize remains separate in the website.
